clue.text: Numbers will contribute to this book collection

definitions.text: Numbers will contribute to this book collection

parts.words: Numbers will contribute to this book collection
parts.note: Numbers looks like arithmetic figures, but it is the fourth book of the Bible, part of the five-book set of Moses

explanation.surface: Someone tallying up how many volumes a library collection will hold.
explanation.definitionFit: The five books of Moses, Genesis through Deuteronomy, form the collection that includes the book of Numbers.

clue.text: Exploited person's security

definitions.meaning: someone used as a tool by more powerful people, like the lowliest chess piece
an item left with a broker as a pledge against a loan

explanation.definitionFit: A pawn is both a person manipulated by others and goods deposited as collateral with a pawnbroker.

clue.text: Girl makes mournful sound when king passes away

indicators.note: the king passing away means his letter departs from the word for a mournful sound

parts.note: a knell is the slow tolling of a bell for a death
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A girl weeps when the monarch dies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passes away' takes K out of KNELL; the surface makes the knell sound for the dead king.
explanation.definitionFit: Nell is a girl's name, a short form of Eleanor or Helen.

clue.text: A drug man with dental problem found in chemists

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
a man is referred to as he
caries is tooth decay

explanation.surface: A drug dealer with toothache turns up at the pharmacy.
explanation.definitionFit: Apothecaries is the old word for pharmacists, people who prepared and sold medicines.

clue.text: Distinctive attitudes of those wanting the last to be first

indicators.text: wanting the last to be first
indicators.note: the final letter of the word those is moved round to the front

explanation.surface: A biblical-sounding remark about people who want the last to be first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting the last to be first' echoes the Gospel phrase 'the last shall be first', but here it moves E from the end of THOSE to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethos is the characteristic spirit and set of attitudes of a group or culture.

clue.text: Herb, right one, put in kitchen pan left out

indicators.note: R and I are placed inside what remains of the kitchen utensil
the letter for left is taken out of the utensil

parts.note: a colander is a perforated kitchen bowl for draining
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: add the right herb to the pan you left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' removes L from COLANDER to leave COANDER; 'put in' sets RI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Coriander is a herb whose leaves and seeds are used in cooking.

clue.text: Splashed around in bog endlessly

indicators.note: the word for a bog loses its final letter, so it has no end

parts.note: a swamp is a bog or marsh

explanation.surface: Someone thrashing about in a marsh that never seems to end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the last letter, P, from SWAMP.
explanation.definitionFit: To have swum, splashing about in the water, is a loose sense of the past tense swam.

clue.text: Physical activity proving fruitful?

definitions.meaning: turning out successfully, as a plan does

explanation.definitionFit: Exercising at the gym and a plan coming good are both described by this phrase.

clue.text: Fellow linked with old civilisation in China, possibly?

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Fellow linked with old civilisation in China, possibly? (10)' reads as a cryptic definition of MANCHURIAN (a fellow of Manchuria, home of the old Manchu), but the held answer is MANCHURIAS; last letter unchecked, so neither can be confirmed
annotationWithheld.clue: Fellow linked with old civilisation in China, possibly?

clue.text: Plant infusion knocked back how I'll sort out innards?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters become the inner part of the reversed drink
the word for an infusion is read backwards, as if downed in a gulp

parts.note: a brew is tea or another infusion

indicators.note: the letters of how I'll are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone downs a herbal tea and wonders how it will settle their insides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' suggests drinking the tea, but it turns the drink round; 'innards' says the rearranged letters sit inside, after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Willowherb is a tall wild plant with pink flowers, also called fireweed.

clue.text: Press club

definitions.meaning: to smooth clothes flat with heat
a golf club with an angled metal head

explanation.definitionFit: An iron is the appliance that presses clothes and also a type of golf club.

clue.text: Where to find rolling pins and food container in kitchen

parts.note: a bowl holds food
a galley is a ship's or aircraft's kitchen

explanation.surface: A list of where the baking tools and dishes are kept in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rolling pins' suggests pastry, but these are skittles knocked down by a rolling ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowling alley is the lane where balls roll to knock down pins.

clue.text: Composer has to shock somehow with intro of Sixth

indicators.note: VI is introduced into the middle of the rearranged letters
the letters of has to shock are put together in some other way

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral six, as in a king or symphony called the Sixth

explanation.surface: A composer sets out to startle the audience with the opening of his Sixth Symphony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sixth' reads as a symphony, but it gives only the Roman numeral; the rearranged letters SHOSTAKOCH take it in, which 'with intro of' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Dmitri Shostakovich was a Soviet composer of fifteen symphonies.

clue.text: Scoundrel for whom someone else has a good word

definitions.text: Scoundrel for whom someone else has a good word

parts.words: Scoundrel for whom someone else has a good word
parts.note: having a good word for someone usually means praising them; here the rogue uses words someone else wrote

explanation.surface: A villain whom another person nonetheless speaks well of.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary thief passes off another writer's phrases as their own work.

clue.text: Experience an early spring going down the lane?

definitions.text: Experience an early spring going down the lane?

parts.words: Experience an early spring going down the lane?
parts.note: an early spring sounds like the season arriving soon, but it is a leap off the line before the starting pistol

explanation.surface: Noticing the first signs of spring while strolling along a country lane.
explanation.definitionFit: To start too soon, like a sprinter leaving their lane before the starting pistol fires.

clue.text: Platform for a mission with otherworldly aims?

definitions.text: Platform for a mission with otherworldly aims?

parts.words: Platform for a mission with otherworldly aims?
parts.note: a mission with otherworldly aims sounds religious, but it is a rocket flight to space

explanation.surface: A pulpit for a missionary preaching about the hereafter.
explanation.definitionFit: The base from which a rocket lifts off on a space mission.

clue.text: Latent talent — what one has to be the other?

definitions.text: Latent talent — what one has to be the other?

parts.words: Latent talent — what one has to be the other?
parts.note: undeveloped ability, and the capacity a person has to become something different

explanation.surface: A musing on hidden gifts and becoming someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Unrealised ability, the capacity to develop into something more, is exactly this word.

clue.text: Drink period bringing two sides together

indicators.note: the period sits between the two sides and so brings them together around it

parts.note: L and R are left and right, the two sides
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A drinking session that unites both factions.
explanation.walkthrough: AGE goes between L and R, left and right.
explanation.definitionFit: Lager is a light beer, a common drink in a pub.

clue.text: Mollusc has one staring in wonder

definitions.meaning: a large burrowing clam with a shell that gapes open

explanation.definitionFit: A gaper is a type of clam and also a person who gapes in amazement.

clue.text: Is it natural at weaving?

indicators.note: the letters of natural at are woven into a new order

explanation.surface: A question about whether some creature is a born weaver.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a spider is a natural at weaving webs.
explanation.definitionFit: A large hairy spider, and spiders are natural web weavers.

clue.text: It's time for high-church cleric to get the sack

definitions.text: It's time for high-church cleric to get the sack

parts.words: It's time for high-church cleric to get the sack
parts.note: getting the sack sounds like dismissal, but it is the penitent's sackcloth worn at the start of Lent

explanation.surface: The bishop has decided a ritualist priest should be fired.
explanation.definitionFit: The first day of Lent, when penitence was traditionally shown in sackcloth and ashes.

clue.text: One may be rattled when generals start to show off

definitions.text: One may be rattled when generals start to show off

parts.words: One may be rattled when generals start to show off
parts.note: rattling sounds like being unnerved, but military men rattle a sword as a show of threat

explanation.surface: Someone is unnerved when the top brass begin to swagger.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavalry sword; rattling one is a figure for making military threats.

clue.text: A man who died in Bolivia in agony

parts.note: the revolutionary Che Guevara was killed in Bolivia in 1967

explanation.surface: A man perished in Bolivia in great pain.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a continuous pain; agony is used loosely for it.

clue.text: Good boy is very willing

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A well-behaved boy eager to help.
explanation.definitionFit: Being glad to do something means being happy and eager to do it.

clue.text: As villain, I love pocketing silver

indicators.note: I and O hold the silver inside them, like a pocket

parts.note: O is love, zero in tennis
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A villain confesses he enjoys stealing the silverware.
explanation.definitionFit: Iago is the scheming villain of Shakespeare's Othello.

clue.text: Twice I had to enter a cold lab, shivering — it's iniquitous

indicators.note: the letters tremble out of order, so they are rearranged
the word Twice says the letter I appears two times in the pool

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone forced to work twice in a freezing laboratory calls it wicked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shivering' rearranges the two Is with ACOLDLAB; the surface's 'had to enter' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabolical means fiendishly wicked, which is what iniquitous describes.

clue.text: Nurse present ultimately at death

indicators.note: only the final letter of present is used

parts.note: one's end is one's death

explanation.surface: A nurse is there at the end of someone's life.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend is to look after, as a nurse does a patient.

clue.text: He's deeply flawed, inwardly a lazy person

indicators.note: the letter A goes inside the rearranged letters
the letters of he's deeply are faulty, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A judgement on a man who is deeply flawed, and lazy at heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flawed' rearranges HESDEEPLY to SLEEPYHED, and 'inwardly' puts A inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleepyhead is a drowsy, idle person who is slow to get up.
